Fab2 produced from human IgG by cathepsin-D digestion is able to produce in animals not given any prior immunization acute and chronic experimental arthritis.

Fab2 produced by cathepsin digestion of IgG induces a chronic synovitis with a histopathological picture very similar to that of rheumatoid arthritis.
